# 1) Package installation and loading

```{r packages}
install_if_missing <- function(pkgs, bioc = FALSE) {
  for (pkg in pkgs) {
    if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
      if (bioc) {
        if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
        BiocManager::install(pkg, ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
      } else {
        install.packages(pkg)
      }
    }
  }
}

cran_pkgs <- c(
  "dplyr", "forcats", "ggplot2", "ggrepel", "matrixStats", "patchwork",
  "pheatmap", "RColorBrewer", "readr", "tibble", "viridis"
)
bioc_pkgs <- c("DESeq2", "EnhancedVolcano", "vsn")

install_if_missing(cran_pkgs, bioc = FALSE)
install_if_missing(bioc_pkgs, bioc = TRUE)
```

# 2) Data import, alignment, and shared preprocessing

```{r load_data}
counts <- read.csv("Merged_Count.csv", row.names = 1, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
coldata <- read.csv("ColData.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

common_samples <- intersect(colnames(counts), rownames(coldata))
counts <- counts[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
coldata <- coldata[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# Recompute quartile labels from continuous variables so results are reproducible
# even when quartile columns are left blank in ColData.csv.
format_threshold <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  out <- format(round(x, digits), nsmall = digits, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
  sub("\\.0$", "", out)
}

make_quartile_labels <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  q1 <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE))
  q3 <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x)   ~ NA_character_,
    x <= q1    ~ paste0("Lower than or equal to ", format_threshold(q1, digits)),
    x >= q3    ~ paste0("Greater than or equal to ", format_threshold(q3, digits)),
    TRUE       ~ "Interquartile range"
  )
}

required_numeric_cols <- c(
  "mvpa_trimester1", "mvpa_trimester2", "mvpa_trimester3", "mvpa_postpartum",
  "sed60num_trimester1", "sed60num_trimester2", "sed60num_trimester3", "sed60num_postpartum"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_numeric_cols, colnames(coldata))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns in ColData.csv: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

coldata <- coldata %>%
  mutate(
    mvpa_quartile_trimester1   = make_quartile_labels(mvpa_trimester1),
    mvpa_quartile_trimester2   = make_quartile_labels(mvpa_trimester2),
    mvpa_quartile_trimester3   = make_quartile_labels(mvpa_trimester3),
    mvpa_quartile_postpartum   = make_quartile_labels(mvpa_postpartum),
    sed60num_quartile_trimester1 = make_quartile_labels(sed60num_trimester1),
    sed60num_quartile_trimester2 = make_quartile_labels(sed60num_trimester2),
    sed60num_quartile_trimester3 = make_quartile_labels(sed60num_trimester3),
    sed60num_quartile_postpartum = make_quartile_labels(sed60num_postpartum)
  )

# Filter low-count miRNAs once and reuse objects across chunks
dds0 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata, design = ~ 1)
dds0 <- dds0[rowSums(counts(dds0) >= 5) >= 3, ]

miRNA_for_background <- rownames(dds0)
write.table(miRNA_for_background, file = "DIANA_background_miRNAs.txt",
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds0, blind = TRUE)
count_mat <- assay(vsd)

# PCA on top variable miRNAs for correlation/regression analyses
n_top <- 500
rv <- rowVars(count_mat)
top_genes <- order(rv, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(n_top, length(rv)))]
mat_top <- count_mat[top_genes, , drop = FALSE]
pc_top <- prcomp(t(mat_top), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
percentVar_top <- 100 * (pc_top$sdev^2) / sum(pc_top$sdev^2)

scores_top <- as.data.frame(pc_top$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  left_join(rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(coldata), var = "Sample"), by = "Sample")

jn_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin = margin(4, 6, 4, 4)
  )
```

# 4) Figure 6 — Correlation analysis and regression plot

```{r fig6}
run_correlation <- function(x, y, method = c("pearson", "spearman"), B = 5000, exact = FALSE) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  complete_idx <- complete.cases(x, y)
  x <- x[complete_idx]
  y <- y[complete_idx]

  if (length(x) < 3) {
    return(list(cor_test = NULL, boot_CI = c(NA_real_, NA_real_), n = length(x)))
  }

  cor_res <- cor.test(x, y, method = method, exact = if (method == "spearman") exact else NULL)
  boot_vals <- replicate(B, {
    idx <- sample(seq_along(x), replace = TRUE)
    cor(x[idx], y[idx], method = method)
  })
  boot_CI <- quantile(boot_vals, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

  list(cor_test = cor_res, boot_CI = boot_CI, n = length(x))
}

PCs <- c("PC1", "PC2")
predictor <- "sed60num_postpartum"
quartile_col <- "sed60num_quartile_postpartum"

for (pc in PCs) {
  res_pearson <- run_correlation(scores_top[[pc]], coldata[[predictor]], method = "pearson", B = 5000)
  res_spearman <- run_correlation(scores_top[[pc]], coldata[[predictor]], method = "spearman", exact = TRUE, B = 5000)

  cat("\nPearson Correlation -", pc, "\n")
  if (is.null(res_pearson$cor_test)) {
    cat("Insufficient complete observations.\n")
  } else {
    print(res_pearson$cor_test)
    cat("Bootstrap 95% CI:\n")
    print(res_pearson$boot_CI)
  }

  cat("\nSpearman Correlation -", pc, "\n")
  if (is.null(res_spearman$cor_test)) {
    cat("Insufficient complete observations.\n")
  } else {
    print(res_spearman$cor_test)
    cat("Bootstrap 95% CI:\n")
    print(res_spearman$boot_CI)
  }
}

plot_df <- scores_top %>%
  mutate(
    Predictor = .data[[predictor]],
    Quartile = factor(.data[[quartile_col]])
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Predictor, y = PC2, color = Quartile)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(

    "Greater than or equal to 431.1" = "royalblue"
  )) +

    title = "PC2 vs. SED60+ (T4) by Quartile",
    x = "Minutes/day in moderate to sedentary bouts greater than or equal to 60 minutes",
    y = "PC2",
    color = "Quartile"
  ) +
```

# 5) Differential expression — DESeq2

```{r deseq2}
run_deseq <- function(coldata, counts, group_col, ref_level, contrast_levels, output_file) {
  coldata_filt <- coldata %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(group_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_col]]), .data[[group_col]] != "Interquartile range") %>%
    mutate(Group = ifelse(grepl("Lower", .data[[group_col]]), "Low", "High")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Group)

  coldata_filt$Group <- factor(coldata_filt$Group, levels = c("Low", "High"))

  if (nrow(coldata_filt) < 2 || length(unique(coldata_filt$Group)) < 2) {
    message("Skipping ", group_col, " due to insufficient Low/High samples.")
    write.csv(data.frame(), output_file, row.names = FALSE)
    return(NULL)
  }

  counts_filt <- counts[, rownames(coldata_filt), drop = FALSE]
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_filt, colData = coldata_filt, design = ~ Group)
  dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) >= 5) >= 3, ]

  if (nrow(dds) == 0) {
    message("No features passed filtering for ", group_col)
    write.csv(data.frame(), output_file, row.names = FALSE)
    return(NULL)
  }

  dds$Group <- relevel(dds$Group, ref = ref_level)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  res <- results(dds, contrast = contrast_levels)

  degs <- na.omit(res[which(res$padj < 0.10), ])
  write.csv(as.data.frame(degs), output_file)
  res
}

results_activity_T1 <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
  "sed60num_quartile_trimester1", "High", c("Group", "Low", "High"),
  "results_activity_T1_DEGs_NAomit.csv")

results_activity_T2 <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
  "sed60num_quartile_trimester2", "High", c("Group", "Low", "High"),
  "results_activity_T2_DEGs_NAomit.csv")

results_activity_T3 <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
  "sed60num_quartile_trimester3", "High", c("Group", "Low", "High"),
  "results_activity_T3_DEGs_NAomit.csv")

results_activity_PP <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
  "sed60num_quartile_postpartum", "High", c("Group", "Low", "High"),
  "results_activity_PP_DEGs_NAomit.csv")
```

# 6) Figure 7 — Volcano plots

```{r fig7}
make_volcano <- function(results_obj, title, subtitle, output_file) {
  if (is.null(results_obj)) {
    message("Skipping volcano plot for ", output_file, " (no DESeq results).")
    return(NULL)
  }

  df <- as.data.frame(results_obj)
  n_total <- sum(!is.na(df$padj))

  p <- EnhancedVolcano(
    df,
    lab = rownames(df),
    x = "log2FoldChange",
    y = "padj",
    title = title,
    subtitle = subtitle,
    titleLabSize = 16,
    subtitleLabSize = 13,
    pCutoff = 0.054,
    FCcutoff = 1.0,
    pointSize = 2.0,
    labSize = 5.0,
    colAlpha = 0.6,
    selectLab = rownames(df)[!is.na(df$padj) & df$padj < 0.054],
    drawConnectors = TRUE,
    widthConnectors = 0.5,
    max.overlaps = 50,
    legendPosition = "right",
    legendLabels = c("NS", "Log2FC", "P-value", "P-value + Log2FC"),
    col = c("grey60", "#0072B2", "#CC79A7", "#009E73"),
    xlim = c(-6, 6),
    ylim = c(0, 3.5),
    caption = paste0("total = ", n_total, " variables")
  ) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 11), axis.title = element_text(size = 13))

  ggsave(output_file, plot = p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
  p
}

fig7A <- make_volcano(results_activity_T1,
  title = "Trimester One Prolonged Sedentary Behavior",
  subtitle = "Average minutes/day in sedentary bouts >=60 min, Q1 vs. Q3",
  output_file = "Figure_7A.tiff")

fig7B <- make_volcano(results_activity_T2,
```
